d: US senator-elect Abdul El-Sayed is calling on Pete Hegseth to resign, accusing the Pentagon chief of mishandling the war with Iran. The demand adds to political pressure on the trump administration over its military actions. Hegseth has also faced an impeachment push in the House, though lawmakers voted to refer the resolution to the judiciary committee rather than approve articles of impeachment. El-Sayed, who is heading to the Senate from Michigan, has made his position clear: he believes Hegseth should step down. Gursshheen Gahllen brings you the details on Firstpost America.
